changes.before: `moco` is the one environment whose rows vary. Six of its 15 rows are at 0 or 1; the other nine are fractional (2/3 four times, 5/6, 3/4, 2/5, 1/3, 1/6), summing with the rest to 36/55. Every row has a recorded tuple key, so a descriptive map is possible. The 1/6 row, for instance, is `distractors=hard, naming=easy, queue_math=easy, symptom_mask=hard, temperature=hard, visible_tests=easy`: six cases, five labelled `overfit_visible_tests`.
